contract_answer.question: Does the ZN-E005 ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0 configuration generalise to paper split 2024 with a finite, healthy-gradient run whose metrics enter the 3-split confirmation aggregate?
contract_answer.conclusion: Reviewed by CODEX(gemini-4-argon). Apply the proposal's per-run disposition and candidate-level aggregate rule exactly. On split 2024 (BL_SPLIT=2024), ZN-E007 is a complete, finite Kaggle Tesla T4 run (24 completed epochs, 1104 steps, early stopping after selected epoch 20; minimum validation MAPE 0.332848 at epoch 19) achieving MAPE 0.336018, Acc@15 0.3475, RMSE 356.790 cycles, MAE 207.485 cycles, DB-MAPE 0.336018, seen-condition MAPE 0.355794 (Acc@15 0.306667), and unseen-condition MAPE 0.158034 (Acc@15 0.7150). Across all three paper splits (ZN-E005 on 2021, ZN-E006 on 42, ZN-E007 on 2024), the ZN-E005 ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0 configuration achieves a 3-split aggregate of MAPE 0.332 ± 0.009, Acc@15 0.334 ± 0.080, and RMSE 383 ± 54 cycles, beating the paper 3-split references on accuracy metrics (CPTransformer MAPE 0.515 ± 0.067 / Acc@15 0.202; CPMLP MAPE 0.558 ± 0.034 / Acc@15 0.297 ± 0.084). However, just as in ZN-E006, diagnostics.json on split 2024 reports overall_gradient_health WARNING because both readout layers exceed the strict 0.50 late near-zero-gradient threshold at step 185: inter_summary has late near-zero fraction 0.568329 and head has 0.523077 (both flagged NEAR_ZERO_DOMINANT). Under the proposal's pre-registered per-run rule (VALID + gradient gate PASS -> KEEP; VALID + gradient gate FAIL -> DISCARD), ZN-E007 is DISCARD, and the 3-split candidate aggregate is formally NOT CONFIRMED (E006 and E007 gate FAIL). The recurring NEAR_ZERO_DOMINANT at head and inter_summary (driven by the ReLU between Linear(192->64) and Linear(64->1)) is a family-level issue that the next family (phase-split curve-encoder, handoff/tasks/T002.md) must address. Masks and activations are HEALTHY, padding is INVARIANT (0.0), and the executed train.py MD5 equals the reviewed workspace file.

main_symptom: On split 2024, the unchanged ResConv-MaskedSummary-H0 configuration achieves strong accuracy metrics (MAPE 0.3360, Acc@15 0.3475, RMSE 356.8 cycles, prediction-target correlation 0.6197, prediction-to-target SD ratio 0.8291; seen MAPE 0.3558, unseen MAPE 0.1580), completing the 3-split aggregate at MAPE 0.332 ± 0.009, Acc@15 0.334 ± 0.080, and RMSE 383 ± 54 cycles. However, it again fails the formal gradient gate with overall_gradient_health WARNING: at step 185, inter_summary reaches a near-zero-gradient fraction of 0.568329 and head reaches 0.523077 (both > 0.50, NEAR_ZERO_DOMINANT). Furthermore, while short-life cells (<500 cycles, 13 cells) have MAPE 0.2633, Acc@15 0.4423, and bias -6.6 cycles (8.39% of total squared error), long-life tail underprediction remains the dominant error source: the 4 middle-life cells (500-1000 cycles) have MAPE 0.4440, Acc@15 0.2300, and bias -153.7 cycles (20.57% of squared error), and the 3 high-EOL cells (>1000 cycles) have MAPE 0.5071, Acc@15 0.0933, and bias -555.5 cycles (71.04% of squared error; combined >=500-cycle cells account for 91.61% of total squared error).

contradicting_evidence: Both readout layers remain actively updating at step 185: inter_summary has grad_to_parameter_ratio 0.0869 and update_ratio 0.00161, while head has grad_to_parameter_ratio 0.8544 and update_ratio 0.000602.
All activation groups report status HEALTHY with active_feature_fraction_min 1.0 and zero nonfinite values across the run.

Training loss drops from 0.05345 at epoch 1 to 0.03174 at epoch 24 (ratio 0.5937), while validation MAPE improves from 0.4830 at epoch 1 to 0.3328 at epoch 19 (selected epoch 20 MAPE 0.3360, Acc@15 0.3475).
causes.interpretation: Across all three splits of the ZN-E005 config (and earlier H9/H2 variants ZN-E002/ZN-E004), the ReLU activation between inter_summary (Linear 192->64) and head (Linear 64->1) produces late near-zero-gradient fractions near or above the 0.50 threshold: 0.4571/0.4308 on split 2021 (ZN-E005), 0.5462/0.5077 on split 42 (ZN-E006), and 0.5683/0.5231 on split 2024 (ZN-E007). When slightly more than half of the 64 ReLU units are inactive on a diagnostic batch, both head weights and the corresponding rows of inter_summary receive exact zero gradients, tripping NEAR_ZERO_DOMINANT. This recurring readout ReLU sparsity is a family-level issue that prevents formal gate confirmation even when 3-split accuracy (MAPE 0.332 ± 0.009, Acc@15 0.334 ± 0.080) substantially outperforms paper baselines, and the next family must address it.
missing_evidence: Whether enriching upstream cycle features via the phase-split curve encoder (ZN-E008, handoff/tasks/T002.md) reduces dead ReLU coordinates in inter_summary below 0.50, or whether the readout projection/activation itself requires structural modification in a subsequent step.

contradicting_evidence: By epoch 20 on split 2024, prediction spread expands markedly compared with splits 2021 and 42: prediction SD is 343.52 cycles vs target SD 414.34 cycles (ratio 0.8291, max prediction 1514.2 cycles) and correlation reaches 0.6197.
Validation MAPE improves monotonically across prefix bins from 0.4604 at prefixes 01-10 (Acc@15 0.260) to 0.2816 at prefixes 76-100 (Acc@15 0.414).
causes.interpretation: Even with wider prediction spread at epoch 20 on split 2024, high-EOL cells (>1000 cycles, 3 cells) suffer a mean bias of -555.5 cycles (MAPE 0.5071, Acc@15 0.0933) and early prefixes (01-10) have MAPE 0.4604 with bias -327.0 cycles. Across all three splits, cells with EOL >= 500 cycles account for over 90% of squared error (91.61% on split 2024). Because prepare.preprocess_cycle concatenates 150 charge points and 150 discharge points into a single 300-point vector, the shared Conv1D stem and residual blocks straddle the index-150 phase boundary and apply identical filters to Zn plating/stripping and cathode insertion/extraction. Splitting charge and discharge into separate Conv1D branches (PhaseSplitResConvMaskedSummary, handoff/tasks/T002.md) directly targets this representation bottleneck.
missing_evidence: Matched split-2021 evaluation of PhaseSplitResConvMaskedSummary (ZN-E008, handoff/tasks/T002.md) against ZN-E005.

contradicting_evidence: Headline validation MAPE is tightly clustered across all three paper splits: 0.3216 (split 2021), 0.3386 (split 42), and 0.3360 (split 2024), giving a 3-split SD of only 0.009.
Padding invariance is exact (0.0 output change) and mask health is HEALTHY across all splits.
causes.interpretation: While 3-split MAPE is remarkably stable (0.332 ± 0.009), the 20-cell validation splits differ substantially in target EOL distribution (target mean 474.5 cycles on split 2024 vs 351.4 on split 42 and 409.9 on split 2021), seen/unseen composition (unseen MAPE 0.1580 on split 2024 vs 0.3663 on split 42), and optimal stopping epoch (epoch 20 on split 2024 vs epoch 8 on split 2021 and epoch 9 on split 42, where split 2024 stayed near MAPE 0.394-0.425 until epoch 17 before breaking through to 0.3328-0.3360 at epochs 19-20). Recording all three splits establishes a complete, rigorous baseline (MAPE 0.332 ± 0.009, Acc@15 0.334 ± 0.080, RMSE 383 ± 54) for the shared-conv family.
missing_evidence: 3-split confirmation metrics for the upcoming phase-split curve-encoder family.

layers.name: cycle_stem
layers.role: Downsample each observed 300-point V/I/Q cycle into local curve features.
layers.reason: Gradient and activation diagnostics are HEALTHY on split 2024 (late grad-to-param ratio 0.0168, late near-zero fraction 0.2611 <= 0.50, late update ratio 0.00194), but sliding a single Conv1D stem across [charge 150 | discharge 150] entangles distinct Zn-ion phases. Replace with dedicated charge_stem and discharge_stem branches in PhaseSplitResConvMaskedSummary (handoff/tasks/T002.md).

layers.role: First shared residual Conv1D block for within-cycle curve-shape encoding.
layers.reason: Individually HEALTHY on split 2024 (late near-zero fraction 0.1724, late update ratio 0.00107), but shares filters across charge and discharge halves. Replace with phase-specific ResidualCurveBlock branches in T002.

layers.name: residual_blocks.1
layers.role: Second shared residual Conv1D block for within-cycle curve-shape encoding.
layers.reason: Individually HEALTHY on split 2024 (late near-zero fraction 0.1296, late update ratio 0.00107), but part of the shared-phase curve encoder whose 3-split record is now complete and closed. Replace with phase-specific ResidualCurveBlock branches in T002.

layers.name: inter_summary
layers.role: Project the masked mean, last-observed, and last-minus-first cycle summary from 192 to 64 dimensions with ReLU.
layers.reason: Flagged WARNING (NEAR_ZERO_DOMINANT) on split 2024 with late near-zero-gradient fraction 0.568329 (> 0.50), matching split 42 (0.546227) and near-threshold split 2021 (0.4571). The ReLU after Linear(192->64) zeroes >50% of summary units on late batches, causing a family-level gradient-gate failure. In ZN-E008 (T002), keep the summary projection matched first to isolate the phase-split curve encoder, then address the inter_summary/head ReLU bottleneck within the new family if NEAR_ZERO_DOMINANT persists.

layers.name: head
layers.role: Map the 64-dimensional ReLU summary representation directly to standardized EOL.
layers.reason: Flagged WARNING (NEAR_ZERO_DOMINANT) on split 2024 with late near-zero-gradient fraction 0.523077 (> 0.50) because over half of its 64 upstream ReLU inputs from inter_summary are zero on the step-185 diagnostic batch. Repair by replacing the upstream curve encoder in T002 and addressing the inter_summary/head ReLU interface in the new family.
